t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 2 baskets - red or yellow. red, purple, brown or pink gnome will give red basket. other gnomes will give yellow basket. one basket gives more mushrooms than the other for some time. supply will run low then you should switch to the other basket. the basket that gives more mushrooms will switch throughout the game

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 baskets - red and yellow. Choosing a red, purple, pink or brown gnome will give you the red basket. Choosing a yellow, green, blue or orange gnome will give you a yellow basket. One of the baskets (red or yellow) will give more mushrooms than the other for a certain period of time before the supply starts to deplete. When this happens its best to go for the other basket. My advice would be to select the depleted basket whenever "x1" appears and to choose the fuller basket when "x5" appears. The basket with more mushrooms will keep switching throughout the game so my advice should hopefully negate that. I would also advise you use 2 "x1" rounds to see which colour basket is giving more mushrooms and then make your decisions based on that. Good luck!!
